proposal_title: Two-Stage Automated QC Pipeline & Verification Metrics
domain_specific_rationale: The separation of QC into Stage 1 (deterministic FFprobe technical validation) and Stage 2 (multimodal/neural semantic validation) establishes clean, distinct latency, failure, and scoring boundaries. This allows R14 to emit granular observability metrics: container validation latency, codec conformance rates, MLLM evaluator latency, score distributions (per QC profile), and low-confidence drift rates. Emitting standardized QCResult telemetry linked to shot_id, take_id, and trace_id enables performance optimization and automated detection of evaluator degradation.
capability_impact: Preserves CAP-11 (Quality Control Pipeline) and CAP-14 (Platform Observability) with structured metric emissions for media validation.
residual_risk: High-frequency frame analysis in Stage 2 MLLM evaluation may introduce telemetry cardinality explosion if per-frame metrics are emitted indiscriminately. Mitigate by aggregating frame-level metrics within R11 and emitting summarized evaluator scores with bounded dimension tags.
